title: Two Stars
text: Two Stars. ring too short, ring not loud

product_metadata.title: 60 Minute Wind Up Timer, Visual Mechanical Timer, from 0 to 60 Minutes, for Kitchen, Hair Color Processing, Tanning Time, Kids' Home and Classroom Activities or Timeouts, Black
features: TIMING IS EVERYTHING: When it comes to hair color and processing, a few minutes could mean the difference between glorious perfection and unmitigated disaster! No worries, though—Colortrak's 60 Minute Wind Up Timer will keep time so you don't have to. A must-have staple in any salon, it's easy to operate and can be set in one-minute increments up to one hour so you can focus on the client and not the clock.

SMALL, SIMPLE AND DISCRETE: Ideal for a multitude of uses, including to time all chemical, coloring, cosmetic and tanning processes, kids' activities, meetings, and more. At only 6 x 5 x 2 inches, this wind up timer is discrete and stands easily on countertops where it'll take up minimal space with maximum helpfulness.

SET AND GO EFFICIENTLY: We've kept it simple with easy, two-step functionality. To set for up to an hour, turn clockwise all the way up to 55 minutes and then turn counter-clockwise to the number of minutes required. To set for a short amount of time, first wind timer past 30 seconds then back to desired time. The bell will ring when time is up!

NO BATTERIES ARE REQUIRED: Don't drain your cell phone battery or put it in danger of chemical and liquid exposure by using its alarm. Instead, keep it simple and professional. The Colortrak 60 minute Wind Up Timer requires no battery or electrical outlet, making it incredibly convenient and safe for even the most crowded workstation.

PUSHING BOUNDARIES WITH COLORTRAK: Colortrak specializes in a line of vibrant, comfortable and effective professional salon products including everything you need for styling, coloring and processing applications. Incorporating ergonomic features, tasteful design, and real-world testing by select brand ambassadors, Colortrak products are pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of hair color.
